Teaching materials I share openly, all under
[CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) --- adapt them,
translate them, use them in your own teaching. Attribution is welcome; asking
permission is not.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Existing resources are archived on the
[Open Science Framework](https://osf.io/nymkd/) and remain freely available
there. New and updated versions will be deposited on Zenodo and listed here.
:::

## Applications and career

My [Principal Fellowship application](https://osf.io/nymkd/) and my 2025
application for promotion to Professor are available on OSF. People writing
their own tend to find them useful, and there is no good reason for them to be
hard to find.

## Hillwalking

### Munro and Corbett picker

A stand-alone planning tool. Give it your postcode, the date and when you can
leave the house, and it lists the Munros and Corbetts you could climb and get
off the hill before sunset, with filters for driving time, region, height,
terrain and the weather forecast. Walk data from
[walkhighlands](https://www.walkhighlands.co.uk/), built alongside the
[Munro](post/2025-08-31-munro-tidy-tuesday/) and
[Corbett](post/2025-09-25-corbetts/) blog posts.

[Open the picker](munro-picker.html)

## Earlier resources

Study skills sessions from 2019 to 2025, the student guides to using lecture
recordings in five languages, and other teaching materials are archived on the
Open Science Framework at [osf.io/nymkd](https://osf.io/nymkd/) and
[osf.io/esd2q](https://osf.io/esd2q/). Both collections remain downloadable
indefinitely.
